index.name: Stephen Nguyen
index.title: Full-stack Developer
index.description: I'm a fresh graduate in Software Engineering with 3 years of study and a 4-month internship. I build responsive, user-friendly interfaces using React and Next.js, and handle backend logic with Express.js and Laravel. Passionate about clean code, modern tech, and building meaningful digital experiences.

about.title: about me
about.description: I am a passionate Fullstack Developer trained at FPT Polytechnic, where I graduated with outstanding academic achievements. Over the years, I have actively participated in various programming competitions at both local and national levels, continuously honing my skills and embracing new technologies. My solid foundation and real-world experience allow me to deliver high-quality web solutions from front to back.

tienPhong.description: Collaborated remotely with a development team to build a real-world project. Participated in regular online meetings to report progress and receive feedback from the client.

work.heading: Selected work
work.subtitle: A mix of team graduation work, personal builds, and UI showcases — presented honestly with what's public, what's private, and what each project actually demonstrates.

fsources.name: Fsources
fsources.title: Graduation capstone — online course platform
fsources.description: Fsources was our team graduation project at FPT Polytechnic — a full online course platform built by multiple members. Source code and deployment details are kept private due to project security requirements.
highlights: Course management, auth, and payment flows
Not publicly deployed — details under NDA

fasco.name: Fasco Shop
fasco.title: Fashion e-commerce learning project
fasco.description: Fasco Shop is a personal fullstack project — an online clothing storefront built to practice Angular, Node.js, and database design. No custom domain; code is available on GitHub for review.
highlights: Product catalog and shopping cart flow
Open-source on GitHub, no live deployment

stech.name: STech
stech.title: Static UI clone — smartphone storefront
stech.description: STech is a front-end skill showcase — a static clone of a smartphone e-commerce interface built with Next.js and Tailwind. Deployed on Vercel to demonstrate layout, responsiveness, and UI polish. No real backend or transactions.
highlights: Static UI clone for portfolio demonstration
Product listing, detail pages, and cart layout
Responsive design with Next.js + Tailwind CSS
Live demo on Vercel — no backend integration
